name: pi-studio
description: A local daemon that owns pi agents: a workspace is a folder, a thread on its board is an agent.

scripts.check: node --check server.ts && node --check public/client/board.js && node --check public/client/git-drawer.js && node --check public/client/terminal-drawer.js && node --check public/client/text-preview.js && node --check public/client/diff-table.js && node --check public/client/chart-umd-min.js && node --check public/client/gitgraph/host.js && node --check public/client/gitgraph/viewer.js && node --check bin/smoke.mjs && node --check bin/check-imports.mjs && node --check bin/pi-studio && node --check bin/runtime.mjs && node --check bin/manage.mjs && node --check bin/install.mjs && node --check bin/build-release.mjs && node --check bin/package-release.mjs && node --check bin/release-notes.mjs && sh -n install.sh && node bin/check-imports.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node --test --test-timeout=90000 && node bin/smoke.mjs
scripts.precheck: node -e "try{require.resolve(\"typescript/package.json\")}catch{console.error(\"pi-studio: npm run check needs the dev dependency, so run npm install once. The daemon itself needs nothing.\");process.exit(1)}"
